description: Four knobs that drive whatever you map them to, standing in for a Kilpatrick Twister USB controller

params.text: Turn it to move the parameter mapped to it, and hold M with the pointer over it to arm it for mapping onto a control elsewhere in the patch

notes: nothing happens until a control here is mapped: hold M with the pointer over it, then click the control in the patch it should drive
the name of the mapped control is printed under the knob once the mapping is made, and the mapping is kept in the patch
the hardware is chosen from the module's menu, and the choice is kept in the patch whether the hardware is plugged in or not, so a patch can be edited without it
clicking the panel away from a control blinks the USB lamp on the hardware, which is how you tell which of several units this module is driving
a Twister Expander placed immediately to the right turns the four knobs into CV outputs and a vMIDI output
menu: MIDI Driver - Twister Module — a heading over the MIDI drivers on this machine
MIDI Devices - Slot 1 — a heading over the devices found on the chosen driver; only Twister hardware is offered
Subscribe to Kilpatrick-Toolbox — opens the maker's other plugin on the VCV library, which holds modules for the vMIDI cables these expanders send
www.kilpatrickaudio.com — opens the maker's page for the hardware in a browser
